players.bio: Adam James Armstrong (born 10 February 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers. Armstrong is a product of the Newcastle United academy and made his professional debut for the club in March 2014.

André Trindade da Costa Neto (born 16 July 2001), simply known as André (Brazilian Portuguese: [ɐ̃ˈdɾɛ]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Brazil national team.

Bertrand Isidore Traoré is a Burkinabé professional footballer who plays as a forward or right winger for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and captains the Burkina Faso national team. After beginning his career at Auxerre, he finished his development at Chelsea, and made his debut in a one-and-a-half-year loan at Vitesse in the Eredivisie.
Boubacar Traoré (born 20 August 2001) is a Malian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Mali national team.

Paulo César Silva Peixoto (born 12 May 1980) is a Portuguese professional football manager and former player who played mainly as a left midfielder and occasionally as a left-back. He is the head coach of EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers.
Enso David González Medina (born 20 January 2005) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a left winger for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Paraguay national team.
Fernando López González (born 24 May 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers.
Ghislain N'Clomande Konan (born 27 December 1995) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Ivory Coast national team.
Hugo Bueno López is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers.
Jackson Tchatchoua is a professional footballer who plays as a full-back or a wing-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers.

Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (French pronunciation: ; born 27 June 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers. Born in France, he represents the Haiti national team.

John Thomas Gordon Ruddy (born 24 October 1986) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers. Ruddy began his career at Cambridge United, before signing for Everton as a 19-year-old. He spent five years with Everton, but made just one appearance, while playing on loan at nine different clubs.

Jordan Anthony James (born 2 July 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers, on loan from Ligue 1 club Rennes, and the Wales national team. James made his senior debut for Birmingham City as a 17-year-old on 2 November 2021, and went on to make 105 appearances in all competitions before signing for Rennes in 2024.
José Pedro Malheiro de Sá (born 17 January 1993) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers.

Kieran John Trippier (born 19 September 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers. Trippier started his career in the youth system at Manchester City but failed to make the breakthrough to the first team, having two loans at Championship club Barnsley.

Ladislav Krejčí (born 20 April 1999) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers., In 2024, the Czech edition of Forbes featured Krejčí in their 30 under 30 list: 30 of the most talented Czechs under 30 years old.

Marshall Nyasha Munetsi (born 22 June 1996) is a Zimbabwean professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers, and captains the Zimbabwe national team.
Mateus Bula Dami Mané (born 16 September 2007) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers.
Yacouba Nasser Djiga (born 15 November 2002) is a Burkinabé professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers, and the Burkina Faso national team.

Rafiki Saïd Ahamada is a Comorian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for English EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Comoros national team. Club career Saïd joined the youth academy of Brest at the age of 11, and signed his first professional contract on 25 May 2000.

Raúl Alonso Jiménez Rodríguez (Latin American Spanish: ; born 5 May 1991) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Mexico national team. Jiménez began his career in Club América's youth system before debuting in the first division in October 2011.
Rodrigo Martins Gomes (born 7 July 2003) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger or wing-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers.

Sean Thomas Neave (born 27 May 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers on loan from Premier League club Newcastle United. He is an England youth international.

Tawanda Blessing Chirewa (born 12 October 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers. Born in England, he represents Zimbabwe internationally.
Thomas Glyn Doyle (born 17 October 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers.

Tote António Gomes (born 16 January 1999), known as Toti, is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for Wolverhampton Wanderers as a defender He made his LigaPro debut for Estoril on 5 May 2019 in a game against Académico Viseu.

Yerson Mosquera Valdelamar (born 2 May 2001) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers. and the Colombia national team. Mosquera made his breakthrough at Atlético Nacional, where he marked his professional debut against River Plate in the Copa Sudamericana in October 2020.
